label: ABU Chief Resident Confirmation
subtitle: Annual Program Director letter to the American Board of Urology
notes: One letter per chief resident, every year, when the ABU opens the Qualifying (Part 1) Examination cycle in September. The Board requires the letter in its office by January 1 of the exam year and the Program Director's Evaluation Form by March 1. The letterhead, signature image and credential block come from the .docx template untouched - never rebuild the letterhead.
content: RE:  {name}, MD — Confirmation of Chief Resident Status
Qualifying (Part 1) Examination, The American Board of Urology

I am writing to confirm that {name}, MD is a chief resident in good standing in the ACGME-accredited Urology Residency Training Program at Montefiore Medical Center and is expected to successfully complete at least six months as chief resident by June 30, {exam_year}.
Dr. {last} entered the Urology Residency Training Program on July 1, {start_year} and is expected to complete the residency program on June 30, {exam_year}.

I understand that a Program Director’s Evaluation Form for each resident who has applied for the examination will be emailed to me and/or our residency coordinator in late January, and I will ensure that each form is completed and returned to the Board office by March 1, {exam_year}.
Please contact me at 347-842-1700 or asankin@montefiore.org with any questions.
